name: Brown, painter
trade: carriage, sign, ornamental and figure painting, and gilding

proprietors.name: Brown
proprietors.basis: The register holds this printed name as person_brown with action 'new_resident': the town does not carry a card for them under an id this record can name, so the reading is the name and not yet a person. Dated by the printing window, which bounds the reading and does not date the partnership.

staff.name: George Lyman
staff.basis: The staffing model puts 1 of this role in a painter's shop at the typical band and 1 at the high end, on directory_1839. 14 painters in 1839; the trade works in pairs. This person is a reconstructed resident of the trade with no workplace of their own; the house is one the business layer already holds, and this row points at it rather than raising anything. Seated by tools/seat_reconstructed_trades_1835.py (T-1433) off 1835_business_staffing_model#painter_shop.painter; carried onto this record by tools/staff_the_houses_1835.py (T-1462).
staff.replaceable_by: a source naming where this person worked, which retires the draw

hands.why_not_drawn: The reconstructed seating had nobody of this trade left to seat here. A source naming a hand at this house would write one in, and T-1448's mint order is the count of what the town still owes it.

staffing.basis: the 1835 business staffing model's band for this class, with the reconstructed seats T-1433 put in this house marked drawn
staffing.replaceable_by: a source naming the hands of this house, which retires every reconstructed seat it covers

shortfall.statement: The staffing model puts 1 hand(s) about this kind of house at its typical band and this house carries 1. It is at its band.
shortfall.counted_here: the reconstructed hands this overlay seats. A hand a SOURCE names carries its own citation in staff[] and is counted by the attested join, not by this.
shortfall.replaceable_by: a source naming a hand at this house, which retires the seat it replaces, or the mint T-1448 ordered, which draws the rest

locations.basis: The register matches this business onto the committed structure brown_boarding_house on its occupants. brown_boarding_house already stands and its occupants carries brown — 'Mrs Rufus Brown; proprietor; and the Brown household'. The papers add trade, goods and dates to a record that exists.

dates.basis: No opening is announced. The first printing, 1835-06-08, is the bound: the house was trading by then and the record does not say when it began.

proprietor_community.basis: This record names nobody the resident layer holds a card for, so there is no person to read a community off. The silence is in the register.

replaceable_by: A directory, a deed or a later reading that names this house's premises, its staff or its dates more exactly than the newspapers do.
